divisions.headline: A gets its first week where the expected top three put forth a bigger week; Beach still looks tough despite 0-3 start
Possee wins big, now averaging almost 18 per week; Inconsistent and Serious each move to 2-0, and each does it in a super nailbiter fashion, with Serious even needing an extra leg
Menace jumps on Mafia early, hangs on for key win in 1001; Projectile sweeps 501 to come back on Hump'N; only 1 of the 12 C matches so far has been a bigger margin than 15-9
Point & Rally gets a critical win, while Knights roll, taking both to 3-0; one match unreported, maybe another 3-0?

matches.note: scoresheet not received by press time

divisions.headline: Blanks take 11 cricket points from Constantly to get to 3-0; Corks and Dartness each post solid wins, each moving to 2-1, and keeping the bottom trio in E still winless to this point

Down to F squeezes past Nein Mark for huge win (but where the heck is Brian Whitley?); Death Throw and Cheap Shots both get narrow wins, move up into F's top two spots; all 9 F matches through three weeks have finished at 15-9 or closer
Rippin rolls into its bye with a third cruiser victory; Banging moves to 2-0, joins Rippin as only still-undefeated G teams; Aim-ing thumps super-shorthanded Machine to take 3rd
SofaKings post third comfortable win, having faced the three 0-3 teams so far; Vision posts big number, closes the point gap a bit; Bright Side rolls, handing Rangers their first loss
